_comment: Single source of truth for down payment assistance program terms.
gen/compliance_check.py enforces this file: a post that names one of these
programs must cite its official URL, must not contain a known stale value,
and must carry an as-of marker when it states a specific figure.
Re-verify against officialUrl before writing any post that cites terms, and
update verifiedOn when you do. Stale verification is itself a failure.

facts.assistanceMax: up to 4% of the loan amount
facts.forgivenessNote: Fully forgiven after 60 months. A sale or refinance inside the first 60 months requires the DPA second lien to be repaid.
